purpose: Source record for three regenerated educational bacterial surface posters
method: Built-in OpenAI image generation. New illustrations from public scientific descriptions; no protein coordinates, sequence-derived models, or source figures supplied to generator.
limitations: Not to scale. Protein silhouettes, density, spacing, orientation and colors are illustrative.
Composite species overviews, not one reconstructed strain.
Surface-localized does not establish residue-level accessibility; uncertainty is retained.
Not exhaustive OMP inventories; images do not constitute MemOrient output or MARSE simulation.

sources.evidence: Cryo-electron tomography; filament count not fixed in illustration.
